end.summary:
Practised finding partners that make 100 using tens numbers and two-digit numbers.
Used jumps on a number line, including 80 to 100 as a 20-jump.
Answered 30 + 70 correctly and explained the 80 + 20 jump.
For 65, gave 45 instead of 35; this mix-up was not corrected later.
Teach-back was not completed.
end.parentNote: Asha practised making 100 and describing jumps on a number line with Vihaan. They explained that moving from 80 to 100 is a jump of 20 and answered the tens-number example correctly. For 65, they mixed up the digits and chose 45 instead of 35; this was not corrected later in the lesson. At home, practise pairs such as 65 + 35 by counting up from 65 to 100 and noting the jump size.
